title: ATG Risk Condition
description: A machine-readable risk condition that declares blind-signing state, escalation requirements, and unresolved threats. Per RFC-0001, opaque payloads must fail closed or escalate. The system MUST NOT imply that an opaque payload was fully verified.

blind_signing.description: True when the payload is opaque and could not be clearly rendered for review.

reason.description: Why the payload is opaque or partially decoded.

required_action.description: Required action. 'escalate_or_abort' is the default for A3/A4. 'abort' denies execution outright.

payload_decode_coverage.description: Estimated fraction of the payload fields that were decoded (0.0 = fully opaque, 1.0 = fully decoded).

unresolved_fields.description: Field names or paths that could not be decoded.

escalation_target.description: Agent, principal, or quorum that should receive the escalation.

override_authorized.description: Whether an override has been explicitly authorized by separate policy and quorum. Must not be set through silent fallback.

override_policy_ref.description: Reference to the override policy if one was invoked.
